summary: Verified all P0 scraper-download visibility fixes and backend endpoints. All 6 backend pytest cases PASS, and all 3 UI hooks (PO dashboard header, Houzz modal banner, AI Design Assistant Panel header) render the correct amber download link with dynamic version 7.47.0 pulled from manifest.json and hrefs resolving to /api/download/chrome-extension.

download-scraper legacy alias still works; consider deprecation notice header in future.
seed_data_creation: None — used existing 'Wheeler Ridge Residence' project.
